## Changes / 改动

Describe the problem, trigger and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

说明解决的问题、触发条件和最终行为。关联 Issue（如有）：

## Validation / 验证

List commands actually run and their results. For documentation-only changes, report link/format checks. For USB/native changes, identify tested hardware or explicitly state it was not tested.

列出实际执行的命令及结果；纯文档改动注明链接和格式检查结果。
涉及 USB/native 时列出真机型号与采集卡，或明确注明未完成硬件验证。

## Checklist / 检查

- [ ] Changes are focused; no credentials, APKs, caches or unrelated formatting / 改动聚焦，未包含凭据、APK、构建缓存或无关格式化
- [ ] Relevant docs and behavior regression tests are updated / 已更新受影响的文档和必要的行为回归测试
- [ ] New/changed dependencies have source, license and notices checked (skip if unchanged) / 新增或变更依赖时已核对来源、许可证和第三方材料（无变更可跳过）

## Limitations / 限制

Untested scenarios, compatibility impact or follow-up work / 尚未验证的场景、兼容性影响或后续事项：
